name: PollOptionDeleted
description: Describes a service message about an option deleted from a poll.

fields.name: poll_message
fields.description: Message containing the poll from which the option was deleted, if known. Note that the [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message) object in this field will not contain the _reply\_to\_message_ field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: option_persistent_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the deleted option

fields.name: option_text_entities
fields.description: Special entities that appear in the _option\_text_
